meta.subject: Bahasa Melayu
meta.purpose: Track progression so a Tingkatan 2 weakness can be backtracked to a relevant Tingkatan 1 prerequisite.

progression_edges.progression: T1 word/phrase pronunciation recognition expands to words, phrases, terms and expressions.
Contextual lexical listening expands and is expected with broader lexical categories.
T1 simple/compound sentence comprehension supports more focused compound-sentence listening and contextual use.
Information extraction from discourse continues with stronger response accuracy expectations.
Experience narration develops toward retelling heard/seen events across formal and informal contexts.
Focused questions develop toward open-ended questions used to elicit opinions.
Relevant answers develop toward proposing multiple problem solutions.
Basic question-answer interaction develops into open-ended questioning in discussion.
Accurate content/fact delivery develops into filtering information before accurate delivery.
Rational exchange of views develops toward giving and obtaining clarification.
Negotiation for agreement continues with stronger rational and grammatical expectations.
Clear critical explanation develops toward more substantive, critical and precise elaboration.
Event commentary/sequencing supports T2 commentary that extracts explicit and implicit information from graphics.

backtrack_policy: When a T2 skill is weak, inspect its T1 predecessor and shared micro-skills. Do not automatically send the learner back a full year; remediate only the prerequisite node that evidence shows is weak.
